scenes.title: A verdade no pátio
scenes.summary: Caleb explains how he accidentally swapped suitcases with Evelyn on Monday's train and panicked at the gate.

scenes.title: Três anos de silêncio
scenes.summary: At the front desk Graham unlocks the blue suitcase for Caleb, who explains the three-year silence with his brother Owen.

scenes.title: O bolo de limão de sexta-feira
scenes.summary: Evelyn recalls what the brothers always ate after Friday piano lessons, giving Tessa a bright baking idea.

scenes.title: Duas cadeiras debaixo da árvore
scenes.summary: Hannah, Tessa, and Graham arrange a quiet corner table under the courtyard tree and check the string of lanterns.

scenes.title: Palavras simples primeiro
scenes.summary: At eleven forty Caleb practices stiff speeches in the courtyard until Hannah helps him choose three simple, honest lines.

scenes.title: Dez para o meio-dia
scenes.summary: At eleven fifty the mailman drops off an official registered letter for Arthur, who sets it aside to greet noon.

scenes.title: Doze badaladas
scenes.summary: Twelve o'clock strikes with an empty gate, Caleb loses hope for a long minute, and then a taxi brakes outside.

scenes.title: A carta de carimbo vermelho
scenes.summary: As Owen steps into the courtyard outside, Arthur opens the landlord's letter inside and turns pale at a sale notice.
